name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-m365-messages-copilot
title: M365 Messages
shortDescription: Review Microsoft 365 service announcements in Copilot through an interactive MCP App.
longDescription: M365 Messages Copilot is an SPFx Copilot Component that brings Microsoft 365 service announcement messages into Microsoft 365 Copilot through an interactive MCP App. It obtains a delegated Microsoft Entra token, connects to a remote MCP server, and renders the returned experience securely in the Copilot canvas.

Users can browse announcements in inline or full-screen views, switch layouts, paginate, sort and filter messages, and open detailed announcement content. The sample demonstrates authenticated MCP Streamable HTTP communication, MCP App resource rendering, host-driven theming, and delegated access to a multi-tenant API.
